en: Sepia-toned image mounted on a decorative dark border, showing a large barge or floating platform used in harbor construction. A steam-powered crane on the barge is hoisting a massive stone block from or into the water. Several workers stand on the barge and a few men sit in small rowing boats tied alongside. In the background is a hilly or cliffed shoreline. The overall look is of early 20th‑century maritime engineering or pier construction.
